name: 92119 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92119 (San Diego) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92119 (San Diego) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92119 (San Diego) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
